slides.texto_titulo: THE MISTAKE THAT WAS RUINING MY SEEDS

slides.texto_overlay: Every packet just... thrown in a box. No order at all.

slides.texto_cuerpo: Sort by planting month, not by plant type. It changes everything.
Fun fact: seeds stored this way stay viable up to 3 years longer.
Week 4: everything finally has a home.
Small system. Real results. Start sorting today.
